│                                                                                                                      │
│ Approve starts the install of the plan shown, and only once this screen has settled: a key pressed before then does  │
│ nothing. Opening, scrolling and closing help are keys too, so the screen settles again after help closes. Back       │
│ returns to the choices. Nothing has been changed yet: nothing on these screens changes anything until you approve    │
│ the plan on the review. Ctrl+C exits.                                                                                │
